arxiv-1507-06400.title: The Odd Generalized Exponential Gompertz Distribution
arxiv-1507-06400.creator: M. A. El-Damcese, Abdelfattah Mustafa,, B. S. El-Desouky and M. E. Mustafa
arxiv-1507-06400.description: Abstract In this paper we propose a new lifetime model, called the odd generalized exponential gompertz distribution, We obtained some of its mathematical properties. Some structural properties of the new distribution are studied. The method of maximum likelihood is used for estimating the model parameters and the observed Fisher’s information matrix is derived.

arxiv-2106-01706.title: EmoDNN: Understanding emotions from short texts through a deep neural network ensemble
arxiv-2106-01706.creator: Sara Kamran, Raziyeh Zall, Mohammad Reza Kangavari, Saeid Hosseini, Sana Rahmani, Wen Hua
arxiv-2106-01706.description: Abstract The latent knowledge in the emotions and the opinions of the individuals that are manifested via social networks are crucial to numerous applications including social management, dynamical processes, and public security. Affective computing, as an interdisciplinary research field, linking artificial intelligence to cognitive inference, is capable to exploit emotion-oriented knowledge from brief contents.

arxiv-2107-06922.title: A Byzantine Fault-Tolerant Consensus Library for Hyperledger Fabric PubID: pubid: 978-0-7381-1420-0/21/$31.00 ©2021 IEEE
arxiv-2107-06922.creator: Artem Barger, Yacov Manevich, Hagar Meir, Yoav Tock
arxiv-2107-06922.description: Abstract Hyperledger Fabric is an enterprise grade permissioned distributed ledger platform that offers modularity for a broad set of industry use cases. One modular component is a pluggable ordering service that establishes consensus on the order of transactions and batches them into blocks.

arxiv-2109-01600.title: Four proofs of the directed Brooks’ Theorem
arxiv-2109-01600.creator: Pierre Aboulker, Guillaume Aubian ( 1 1 ) DIENS, École normale supérieure, CNRS, PSL University, Paris, France( 2 2 ) Université de Paris, CNRS, IRIF, F-75006, Paris, France.
arxiv-2109-01600.description: Abstract We give four new proofs of the directed version of Brook’s Theorem and an NP-completeness result. 1 Introduction A k -colouring of an undirected graph G is a partition V_{1},\dots,V_{k} of V(G) into k independent sets. The chromatic number of G , denoted \chi(G) , is the least k such that G admits a k -colouring.

arxiv-2208-02070.title: Efficient Fine-Tuning of Compressed Language Models with Learners
arxiv-2208-02070.creator: Danilo Vucetic, Mohammadreza Tayaranian, Maryam Ziaeefard, James J. Clark, Brett H. Meyer, Warren J. Gross
arxiv-2208-02070.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Danilo Vucetic, Mohammadreza Tayaranian, Maryam Ziaeefard, James J. Clark, Brett H. Meyer, Warren J. Gross. Fine-tuning BERT-based models is resource-intensive in memory, computation, and time. While many prior works aim to improve inference efficiency via compression techniques, e.g., pruning, these works do not explicitly address the computational challenges of training to downstream tasks. We introduce Learner modules and priming, novel methods for fine-tuning that exploit the overparameterization of pre-trained language models to gain benefits in convergence speed and resource utilization.

arxiv-2210-15033.description: Abstract Endoscopy is the most widely used imaging technique for the diagnosis of cancerous lesions in hollow organs. However, endoscopic images are often affected by illumination artefacts: image parts may be over- or underexposed according to the light source pose and the tissue orientation.

arxiv-2304-08169.title: Polarization State Conversion through Chiral Butterfly Meta-Structure
arxiv-2304-08169.creator: Hicham Mangach, Younes Achaoui, Muamer Kadic, Abdenbi Bouzid, Sébastien Guenneau, Shuwen Zeng
arxiv-2304-08169.description: Abstract The recent emergence of chirality in mechanical metamaterials has revolutionized the field, enabling achievements in wave propagation and polarization control. Despite being an intrinsic feature of some molecules and ubiquitous in our surroundings, the incorporation of chirality into mechanical systems has only gained widespread recognition in the last few years.

arxiv-2305-17766.title: Revisiting b → c ​ τ ​ ν b\to c\tau\nu anomalies with charged Higgs boson
arxiv-2305-17766.creator: Nilakshi Das, Amit Adhikary, Rupak Dutta
arxiv-2305-17766.description: Abstract Recent experimental measurements on the anomalies observed in B meson decays have pointed towards the possibility of new physics. The LHCb collaboration has reported a significant deviation, exceeding 3.2 ​ σ 3.2\sigma , from the predictions of the standard model.

arxiv-2306-03236.title: A Study of Global and Episodic Bonuses for Exploration in Contextual MDPs
arxiv-2306-03236.creator: Mikael Henaff, Minqi Jiang, Roberta Raileanu
arxiv-2306-03236.description: Abstract Exploration in environments which differ across episodes has received increasing attention in recent years. Current methods use some combination of global novelty bonuses , computed using the agent’s entire training experience, and episodic novelty bonuses , computed using only experience from the current episode. However, the use of these two types of bonuses has been ad-hoc and poorly understood.

arxiv-2309-05215.title: A discrete uniformization theorem for decorated piecewise Euclidean metrics on surfaces Thanks: MSC (2020): 52C26
arxiv-2309-05215.creator: Xu Xu, Chao Zheng
arxiv-2309-05215.description: Abstract . In this paper, we introduce a new discretization of the Gaussian curvature on surfaces, which is defined as the quotient of the angle defect and the area of some dual cell of a weighted triangulation at the conic singularity. A discrete uniformization theorem for this discrete Gaussian curvature is established on surfaces with non-positive Euler number.

arxiv-2310-15432.title: A Review of Economic Incentives for Efficient Operation of Flexible Transmission Thanks: This research was supported by the National Science Foundation under grant number 2146531.
arxiv-2310-15432.creator: Xinyang Rui, Omid Mirzapour, Brittany Pruneau, Mostafa Sahraei-Ardakani
arxiv-2310-15432.description: Abstract The growing penetration of renewable energy requires upgrades to the transmission network to ensure the deliverability of renewable generation. As an efficient alternative to transmission expansion, flexible transmission technologies, whose benefits have been widely studied, can alleviate transmission system congestion and enhance renewable energy integration.

arxiv-2410-10380.title: Dynamics of McMillan mappings III. Symmetric map with mixed nonlinearity
arxiv-2410-10380.creator: T. Zolkin, S. Nagaitsev, I. Morozov, S. Kladov
arxiv-2410-10380.description: Abstract This article extends the study of the dynamical properties of the symmetric McMillan map, emphasizing its utility in understanding and modeling complex nonlinear systems. Although the map features six parameters, we demonstrate that only two are irreducible: the linearized rotation number at the fixed point and a nonlinear parameter representing the ratio of terms in the biquadratic invariant.

arxiv-2412-15349.title: Adaptive Urban Planning: A Hybrid Framework for Balanced City Development
arxiv-2412-15349.creator: Pratham Singla, Ayush Singh, Adesh Gupta, Shivank Garg
arxiv-2412-15349.description: Abstract Urban planning faces a critical challenge in balancing city-wide infrastructure needs with localized demographic preferences, particularly in rapidly developing regions. Although existing approaches typically focus on top-down optimization or bottom-up community planning, only some frameworks successfully integrate both perspectives. Our methodology employs a two-tier approach: First, a deterministic solver optimizes basic infrastructure requirements in the city region.

arxiv-2503-02203.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Yonghwi Kim, Kai-Kit Wong. Nonlinear self-interference (SI) cancellation is essential for mitigating the impact of transmitter-side nonlinearity on overall SI cancellation performance in flexible duplex systems, including in-band full-duplex (IBFD) and sub-band full-duplex (SBFD). Digital SI cancellation (SIC) must address the nonlinearity in the power amplifier (PA) and the in-phase/quadrature-phase (IQ) imbalance from up/down converters at the base station (BS), in addition to analog SIC.

arxiv-2507-01673.title: Facial Emotion Learning with Text-Guided Multiview Fusion via Vision-Language Model for 3D/4D Facial Expression Recognition Journal: journal
arxiv-2507-01673.creator: Muzammil Behzad
arxiv-2507-01673.description: Abstract Facial expression recognition (FER) in 3D and 4D domains presents a significant challenge in affective computing due to the complexity of spatial and temporal facial dynamics. Its success is crucial for advancing applications in human behavior understanding, healthcare monitoring, and human-computer interaction.

arxiv-2508-05348.creator: Riccardo Castellano, Pavel Sekatski

arxiv-2508-13512.title: CountingStars: Low-overhead Network-wide Measurement in LEO Mega-constellation Networks
arxiv-2508-13512.creator: Xiyuan Liu 1 , Guanzuo Liu 1 , Xiucheng Tian 1 , and Wenting Wei 1
arxiv-2508-13512.description: Abstract The high mobility of satellites in Low Earth Orbit (LEO) mega-constellations induces a highly dynamic network topology, leading to many problems like frequent service disruptions. To mitigate this, Packet-based Load Balancing (PBLB) is employed. However, this paradigm shift introduces two critical challenges for network measurement stemming from the requirement for port-level granularity: memory inflation and severe hash collisions.

pmc-11821957.title: Singlet spin order in spin pairs coupled via non-bonded interactions
pmc-11821957.creator: Giuseppe Pileio, Dolnapa Yamano, Craig D. Eccles, Graham J. Tizzard, Sam Thompson
pmc-11821957.description: Fluorine spin pairs that are constrained in spatial proximity show large scalar spin-spin couplings, despite the atoms being separated by several bonds. This is due to a non-bonded atomic interaction related to partial overlapping of fluorine p-orbitals. In this paper we exploit this phenomenon to create long-lived singlet spin order on the fluorine spin pair.

pmc-12564587.title: Diagnostic Pitfalls of Prosthetic Valve Endocarditis: From Sacroiliitis to Coronary Septic Embolization
pmc-12564587.creator: Camelia Bianca Rus, Corina Cinezan, Elad Asher
pmc-12564587.description: Background: Transcatheter aortic valve implantation (TAVI) is an established treatment for severe aortic stenosis in elderly and high-risk patients. However, prosthetic valve endocarditis (PVE) remains a rare but devastating complication. Its diagnosis is often delayed due to atypical clinical manifestations and the frequent occurrence of culture-negative endocarditis.

pmc-12629800.title: Vorapaxar enhanced mitochondria-associated ferroptosis primes cancer immunotherapy via targeting FOXO1/HMOX1 axis
pmc-12629800.creator: Qian Zhou, Yuming Sun, Songtao Du, Yating Dian, Lei Yao, Hui Su, Ziyu Guo, Yu Meng, Yixiao Xiong, Zhili Deng, Xinwei Kuang, Xiaowei Liang, Hong Liu, Guangtong Deng, Xiang Chen, Furong Zeng
pmc-12629800.description: SummaryImmunotherapy has revolutionized cancer treatment, yet challenges persist, such as resistance and lethal thromboembolism, necessitating dual-purpose strategies. Targeting ferroptosis emerges as a promising strategy to enhance immunotherapy efficacy, prompting our investigation of antiplatelet agents that simultaneously promote ferroptosis and mitigate thromboembolic risks.

pmc-12872327.description: IntroductionA novel set of pyramided lines for durable blast resistance was developed using marker-assisted backcross breeding (MABB) strategy in the genetic background of the aromatic landrace Mushk Budji (MB).MethodsSimultaneous-but-stepwise transfer of the blast resistance genes Pi54 and Pi9 was achieved through the integration of foreground selection (FS) and background genome recovery processes, aided by genome-wide SSR and >1500 KASP markers.

pmc-13036797.title: A thermochromic polyoxovanadate with a 200 000-fold conductivity gain for boosting zinc-ion battery performance
pmc-13036797.creator: Ze-Xun Zhang, Xiao-Yue Zhang, Ping-Wei Cai, Shou-Tian Zheng, Cai Sun
pmc-13036797.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The performance of zinc-ion batteries is hampered by the cathode's limited Zn2+ intercalation capacity and sluggish kinetics. Herein, we propose, for the first time, a thermochromic charge-separation strategy that simultaneously enhances capacity, rate performance, and cycling stability.

pmc-13217589.title: The Efficacy and Safety of Intranasal Dexmedetomidine Spray Followed by Nitrous Oxide for Paediatric Oral Procedures
pmc-13217589.creator: Yu-Jie Xiao, Hong-Yu Zhang, Meng-Di Nie, Guo-Sheng Liu, Wei Peng, Ji-Hong Zhao, Zhen-Hao Hu, Huan Sun, Yang Wu
pmc-13217589.description: Introduction and aimsThe management of uncooperative children requiring complex outpatient oral procedures presents a significant clinical challenge. This study aimed to evaluate the safety and efficacy of intranasal dexmedetomidine (DEX) spray combined with nitrous oxide/oxygen (N₂O/O₂) inhalation sedation for the extraction of impacted supernumerary teeth in paediatric patients.

pmc-13412373.title: Reasons for Termination of Treadmill and Cycle Ergometer Exercise Tests in Patients After Myocardial Infarction: The Role of Clinical Profile and Exercise Capacity
pmc-13412373.creator: Beata Czechowska, Jacek Chrzczanowicz, Rafał Gawor, Joanna Kostka

pmc-13584368.description: BackgroundEquity in maternal health is critical to achieving Sustainable Development Goals and Universal Health Coverage.
